title: Bag is ok, could use a rectangle shaped bowl.
text:
Bag is ok, could use a rectangle shaped bowl.. I love the portion control of these containers. Sadly, they seem small, but the reality is, we just eat too much. It would be nice if they had at least one rectangle shaped container to hold longer vegetables such as carrots, celery or asparagus.

The insulated bag is just ok. it's not great, I feel it could be a better insulated bag for the price.

The bowls are nothing to shout about. They are just regular storage containers with measurements on the sides. They should have put more thought in to the bag.

For the price, I would expect a bit more.
